:''Not to be confused with {{Name|Nautilus Shell|class=inline}}.
The '''Nautilus Fossil''' is an [[Artifacts|Artifact]] that can be found in [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]], [[Mining#Bone Node|Bone Nodes]] on the [[Ginger Island]] Dig Site, or by digging up an [[Artifact Spot]] at [[the Beach]].

==Donation==
Donation of this item contributes to the total count of donations for the [[Museum]].

==Bone Mill==
The Nautilus Fossil can be turned into [[Quality Fertilizer]], [[Speed-Gro]], [[Deluxe Speed-Gro]] or [[Tree Fertilizer]] in the [[Bone Mill]].

==Bundles==
Nautilus Fossil is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Recipes==
Nautilus Fossil is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Nautilus Fossil can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Excavator Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt208.png|24px]]

==Quests==
*[[Quests#Fragments of the past|"Fragments of the past"]]: [[Gunther]] may make a request on the [[Quests#List of Special Orders|Special Orders board]] for 100 of any combination of bone items that must be gathered while the quest is active. You have 7 days to complete the quest. The reward is {{Price|3500}} and the [[Bone Mill]] recipe.
